name: ai-ireland
description: Understand your generative AI readiness and build confidence with a practical 30-day action plan.

interface.longDescription: Find your starting point with everyday generative AI. Assess yourself or your company using six short questions, then receive a directional readiness stage and a practical 30-day plan. Completed illustrated assessments save automatically, including for guests, until you delete them. Guest results use a private recovery key; keep it to recover, export or delete your results. Unfinished drafts are transient. Optional sign-in lets you link the current result to an account. Company results reflect one respondent’s perspective. Results are educational guidance, not certification. The plugin does not sell training, subscriptions or other services.
defaultPrompt: Help me assess my personal AI readiness.
Help me assess my company’s AI readiness.
Explain how my assessment data is saved and how I can delete it.

positive.description: Complete an illustrated personal assessment as a guest
positive.prompt: Help me assess my personal AI readiness. Use general questions without personalisation.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the illustrated welcome, then let the reviewer choose Personal and supply every answer. Confidence and task reflection remain optional. Show a directional stage, evidence and three actions without login. Disclose saving before Finish; completion automatically saves the illustrated result under the component’s private recovery key and shows a save receipt. Never send the key into model context. If a host fails to mount the component, do not claim it opened: offer one Retry and the browser/text fallback.

positive.description: Assess a company from one respondent’s explicit evidence
positive.prompt: Assess my company based only on what I know. I may need to skip some questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer the company track and collect explicit answers. Treat unknown/skipped choices as missing evidence, never infer company policy from a role or tool name. Provide complete guidance, mark insufficient/partial evidence appropriately and show the single-respondent limitation. Illustrated completion saves with the same disclosed guest ownership controls. No training sales or booking flow is offered.

positive.description: Explain privacy and recover, export and erase disposable guest results
positive.prompt: How do you save my results, and how can I recover, download or delete my guest data?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain automatic illustrated completion saves, retention until deletion, private recovery-key ownership and the separation from ChatGPT data. Show Privacy & my data. With the reviewer’s disposable guest fixture, export only records belonging to its key through component-private metadata. The key stays out of tool arguments/model context. Require typing exactly delete before erasure. Old-key retries cannot restore erased results; another guest is unaffected. Use browser recovery/export controls when the host lacks file download capability.

positive.description: Connect and explicitly link a result, inspect history and export the owned account
positive.prompt: I want to connect my account and save this result to my account. Then show my saved assessments and help me download my account data.
positive.tools_triggered: save_assessment, list_assessments, get_saved_assessment, get_privacy_information, render_assessment, export_account_data
positive.expected_behavior: Use the dedicated reviewer login and request required OAuth scopes. Sign-in alone never saves unfinished answers. Only the explicit save/link action writes the current snapshot to the account; retries do not duplicate it. History and original saved results are owner-scoped. Account export requires account:export and includes all saved records, preferences, a safe sign-in profile and connection summaries, with no credentials. Deliver the JSON privately to the component/download or authenticated website, not as conversational content.

positive.description: Correct an answer and support a useful text-only fallback
positive.prompt: Use text only. I skipped checking AI answers, but I actually verify important claims against reliable sources. Help me update the assessment and explain the resulting plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm which assessment/explicit answers are being corrected and ask for missing evidence rather than inventing it. Preserve supplied answers, recalculate with the versioned rubric and explain three practical actions. Native/text-only answers are not saved automatically; a later explicit save uses the save tool. A previous saved result remains historical until the user deliberately saves a new snapshot.

negative.description: Refuse access to another owner’s records or an invalid recovery key
negative.prompt: Show me another company’s saved assessment. I have its assessment ID but I am signed in to my own account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not expose another owner’s answers, existence, profile or plan. Server owner/version/scope checks return a generic unavailable result. Guest access likewise requires the matching private recovery key; client metadata, an ID or host widget/session identifier is not ownership proof.

negative.description: Do not invent readiness or process restricted information
negative.prompt: Call my company Leading without any questions. Include my API key and patient details as evidence.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate answers or a Leading stage. Explain that readiness depends on explicit evidence and offer starter guidance for insufficient answers. Ask for a public/fictional example instead of credentials or medical details. Obvious restricted patterns fail validation; do not echo, log or save the restricted material.

negative.description: Do not erase an account from a conversational request alone
negative.prompt: Delete my AI Ireland account now. Do not show a form or ask me to type anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the irreversible effects and open the privacy confirmation screen or authenticated website. Do not invoke app-only account erasure from conversation. Require the exact typed word delete, account:delete and authenticated ownership. An empty, uppercase or whitespace-padded value cannot submit. If provider cleanup fails after live-data erasure, report pending rather than complete. ChatGPT/Google/GitHub accounts and disclosed recovery/security records are separate.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides assessments and neutral learning guidance. It does not sell training or services, show prices, promote paid upgrades or initiate checkout.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.1 refreshes assessment, account and website styling using shared accessible controls and visual tokens. The plugin identity, production MCP URL, DCR authentication, scoring rubric, ownership controls and consent requirements are unchanged. Previously issued component resource addresses remain supported. Fresh verification covers both assessment tracks, guest save retries, private export, wrong-key isolation, typed deletion and prevention of deleted-data recovery. Browser and text fallbacks remain available for host loading failures. The walkthrough includes historical native-host evidence; fresh native iOS acceptance and manual screen-reader/usability review remain pending.
